entities.summary: Linda Jo Rizzo is a German singer, songwriter and producer. Originally from the United States, she was a photo model and studied nutrition in New York. There she met Bobby Orlando and participated in his group, the Flirts, from 1983 to 1984. In 1984, Rizzo moved to Germany and started her own music career there.
